name: EmailTemplate
description: Per-app email template (plan-54). One row per (tenantId, name); subject and body carry the renderable content. Source of truth is Trillo AI (TrilloMD row with modelClassName="EmailTemplate" — see plan-54 design doc); AOS is a read-only consumer that the deploy populates via DeployAppMetadata.bootstrapEmailTemplates (upsert by name). dataApi: open with admin read-only ACL enforces 'no management UI on AOS' — admin can read via /data/EmailTemplate/* but generic create/update/delete are blocked. Edits happen in Trillo AI, ship via redeploy.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Template lookup key. Conventional names: welcome, resendVerification, resetPassword, accountActivation, invitation. App-custom templates use any unique-per-tenant name (e.g., 'order_shipped'). Composite unique constraint on (tenantId, name) enforced at the application layer until composite-index declaration ships in ClassM.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Email subject line. May reference template variables — e.g., 'Welcome to {{{appName}}}'.

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: Email body content. HTML when isHtml=true (the default); plain text otherwise. Variables are {{{var}}} simple-replace placeholders rendered at send time.

attributes.name: isHtml
attributes.description: Whether body should be sent as HTML (true, default) or plain text (false).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Admin-facing description of when this template fires. Optional.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Discriminator. 'system' templates are the standard auth-flow set (welcome / verify / reset / activation / invitation) deployed from Trillo AI's starter content. 'app-custom' templates are app-specific flows the developer added in Trillo AI (e.g., transactional notifications). Both are deployed identically; the discriminator helps UIs filter and reset.
